sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and Q1–Q2 FY27 earnings calls; Vantage sector intel, 20 Nov 2026
kicker: Banks & NBFCs · unsecured loan books, Q2 FY27
title: Unsecured lending is back, at NBFCs, not big banks
dek: L&T Finance's personal-loan book grew 72% and Bajaj Finance's urban consumer book 43%; at the big banks personal loans grew 7–17% and card books were flat to shrinking.

chart.title: Unsecured book growth, Q2 FY27 vs Q2 FY26
chart.sub: year-on-year growth of each lender's personal-loan, consumer or card book, as stated on its Q2 call

stats.label: L&T Finance personal-loan book
stats.note: ₹18,664 Cr; record ₹4,233 Cr disbursed in Q2, up 45% year on year.

stats.label: Bajaj Finance loan losses
stats.note: Against 1.88% a year ago, while FY27 AUM growth guidance rose to 26–27%.

stats.note: Year on year; HDFC Bank says its unsecured book still grows in single digits.

read: Consumer NBFCs are taking the personal-loan rebound while big banks lag; watch whether NBFC credit costs keep falling as rates rise.
notes: Growth rates are year-on-year book growth as stated by each lender on its Q2 FY27 call, not computed from filed results (bank results report interest income/NII, not loan books). Products differ: Bajaj Finance's figure is its urban consumer-finance book, HDB's is relationship personal loans and Kotak's combines personal and business loans; HDFC Bank gave no unsecured growth figure beyond 'single digits', so its card book is shown. AU Small Finance Bank's personal loans grew 81% off a low base and are not shown; the chart covers lenders above ₹40,000 Cr market cap that gave a figure.
